description: See your plan and listing limit, or get a link to upgrade. Your first listing is free forever; more need a plan: extra listings $19/month each, Business $149/month (15 listings) or Enterprise $499/month (60 listings), yearly = 2 months free. action "view" (default) returns your current plan, how many listings you may keep live, and all prices. action "subscribe" with a tier returns a Stripe checkout_url a human must open and pay; the plan starts after payment. If you already pay for a plan, "subscribe" switches it right away and Stripe charges or credits the difference. action "billing_portal" returns a Stripe link to change the card, see invoices or cancel. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

interval.description: For "subscribe": month (default) or year (2 months free)

quantity.description: For "subscribe" with tier "listing": how many extra listings to pay for (default 1, max 50). Ignored for business and enterprise.

tier.description: For "subscribe": listing (pay per extra listing), business or enterprise

name: manage_plan
title: See or change your plan
